Project Description Document
Project name: Madre de Dios Forest Conservation Project
Project location: Madre de Dios, Republic of Peru
Project proponent address: Puerto Maldonado, Madre de Dios, Republic of Peru

Title and reference of methodology applied
VM0007 REDD+ Methodology Framework Version 1.6

1.1 Project Description
The project protects intact tropical forest and adjacent community use areas.

2.4 Baseline scenario
The baseline scenario is continued forest conversion driven by agricultural expansion.

2.5 Additionality
The project is additional because the conservation program depends on carbon finance to overcome investment barriers.

3.3 Monitoring
Monitoring procedures describe plot remeasurement, patrol records, and annual review of safeguards evidence.

3.4 Leakage
Leakage is managed through community livelihood support and surveillance in nearby forest-use areas.
